title: Badge Reflects Status
description: One glance at the Billing table should tell a dispatcher whether an invoice is still owed or already settled — that's the whole job of the status Badge next to each amount.
successCondition: On /billing, a freshly generated invoice (status "open") renders its Badge with warning tone and the text "open"; after a successful payment, the same row's Badge updates to success tone and the text "paid" — without a full page reload, purely from the client-side state update following the pay action.
hints: Badge tone comes straight from the invoice's status field — "paid" maps to success, anything else maps to warning.
Use a card number other than the two known decline/timeout numbers so the payment actually succeeds.
